entities.summary: Anna Caritas Nitschmann, Countess von Zinzendorf und Pottendorf, was a Moravian Brethren missionary (Missionarin), lyrical poet, and the second wife of Count Nicolaus Ludwig Zinzendorf. By virtue of her marriage, she became a member of the House of Zinzendorf, one of the most prominent noble families in the region.
